summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 9.5.1 added backup module notes, support for FortiOS 7.4.2 and 7.4.3 and the mac_address data type, pinned documented version numbers, and raised the required ansible-core to 2.15.
questions: What ansible-core version does fortinet.fortios require?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 9.5.1 changes
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 9.5.1, `fortinet.fortios` requires **ansible-core 2.15** or newer, supports **FortiOS 7.4.2 and 7.4.3**, and supports the `mac_address` data type.
